The '''Ki Battery''' restores '''50%''' of your max ki at once. After using one you must wait 3 seconds before using another.

<translate>
== Getting it ==

* '''Crafting table:''' <code>R L R / L G L / R L R</code>, where R is Redstone, L is Lapis Lazuli and G is a Gete Ingot (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Gete Tech|Gete Tech]]).
* Bulma's '''Ki Accumulator''' sidequest rewards 3 Ki Batteries.
